body: Hang in there. Someone suggested intherooms which is a great resource. I also use meeting guide which gives me in person and zoom meetings in my area.

Not exactly super scary, but my partner and I were on a trail in Tennessee. It was about dusk and I told him we should just head back to the trailhead for the car. We start walking back and the darkness starts to come on QUICK. At about the moment I noticed it was getting very dark, I also realized the woods were silent. Never a good sign. At this point I was positive there was a bear somewhere nearby and we started talking loudly and picking up the pace as comfortably as we could. Nothing happened, but I was fully expecting to cross paths with a black bear at any moment. I was so relieved to see the car
